name: Photo Synth (for phone)
description: Turn two photos into an instrument. Drag across the first and the colour under your finger becomes a tone — hue sets the pitch, saturation the waveform, brightness the loudness. Touch the second and its colour drives a virtual-analog ladder filter. Photos come from the camera or the camera roll, a latch holds the cursor in place, and an on-screen keyboard or an imported MIDI file sets the base note. Records and exports 24-bit WAV.
